description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the 'Communicator' class and related classes for inter-process communication, including process shutdown management, dynamic loader path handling, and RPC message handling within the WPEFramework RPC namespace.

classes.name: DynamicLoaderPaths
classes.description: Manages dynamic loader paths by reading configuration files and default directories.

classes.name: ProcessShutdown
classes.description: Handles process shutdown and destruction of monitorable processes, running in a separate thread.

methods.name: ReadList
methods.description: Reads a list of paths from a configuration file, supporting include directives.

methods.name: ForceDestruct
methods.description: Forcefully destructs a process by ID, killing and removing it from the destructor map.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Schedules a process for destruction if not already terminated.

methods.name: WaitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for all scheduled destructors to complete, optionally filtering by parent connection.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Thread worker function that manages timed destruction of processes.
